doc: Earth-equivalent |latitude| (degrees) per row: min(|degrees(lat)| / hadley_deg * 30, 65) where 65 = EARTH_CAP_DEG - ZONE_DEG / 2 (past it the zones of Earth's ice-contaminated caps are replaced by the 62.5..67.5 zone). A float32 latitude array: np.degrees and the arithmetic stay float32 (the output is float32). Float32 chain of 4 operations: 1e-5.
